name: sounds-minimal
description: Very short, quiet clicks and ticks for a subtle signal: a tick when tests pass, two low ticks when they fail, a click when a call is blocked, a soft tick when a turn ends.

volume.title: Volume
volume.description: Playback gain for every sound: 1 is the file as recorded, 0 is silent, 2 is twice as loud.

quiet.title: Quiet turn end
quiet.description: Turn off the sound that plays when a turn finishes. Test and blocked-call sounds stay on.
